description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Returns' that extends a base system engine model. The class provides methods for retrieving and counting return data from a database, including filtering by date and return status, and grouping results by time intervals such as day, week, month, or year. The class is part of the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Extension.Opencart.Report'.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: A model class for handling return report data within the OpenCart admin extension for reports.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves return records from the database, with optional filtering by return status, date range, and grouping by day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns matching certain filtering criteria, grouped by the specified period grouping.
